note: Nursery relationship register (DAL-80). One record per monitored nursery. Source of truth for who we can contact, what we have said to them, and what is outstanding. Referral click counts are NOT stored here: nursery_crm.py pulls them live from Plausible so they cannot go stale. Contact details were researched in March 2026 and were only recorded in a Linear comment until now, which is why they were unusable. Touches are recorded only where there is evidence; 'evidence' names where that evidence lives. Absence of a touch means we have no record of one, not proof none happened.

WA only via concierge resellers, no in-house bulk. Wants to eventually but needs a separate treatment area.
